# Flowgrid

Flowgrid is a digital systems and design studio helping growing businesses connect operations, client communication, custom web software, and AI voice workflows.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://flowgridco.in/): Business systems, AI voice automation, client communication solutions, and custom web software.
- [About Flowgrid](https://flowgridco.in/about): Team, working process, services, and frequently asked questions.
- [Capabilities and projects](https://flowgridco.in/projects): Flowgrid service areas and selected project case studies.
